_purpose: Ratchet baselines for the donor audits. Each number is the highest problem count that was true and recorded at the stated date. A run that produces MORE problems than this baseline fails; producing fewer requires lowering the baseline in the same change, so donor drift cannot be re-introduced silently.
donor_gate_note: eng/check-donor-sources.py --local-only: 17 issues across 23 bindings, all 'no app-local source tree' for declared-but-never-vendored donors. These pre-date the 30 October pinning work; none of them comes from a pin.
census_note: eng/development/donor_policy.py census: 29 donor rows, 0 violations, 6 findings. Findings are recorded drift (Rnote patches absent from the consumed pin, fork not consumed yet, Avalonia and Files as loose vendored trees) and stay visible in the log.
coverage_note: eng/development/donor_coverage.py audit: 28 specification designations over 25 distinct donors against 18 registry bindings. Problems are designated-but-undeclared donors (Avalonia, Strata, Godot, Blender, VirtualBox, CoMaps, Lawnchair, Gitea, Gitnuro, cakemods, Element/Matrix, Thunderbird, GNOME system-monitor) plus registry bindings whose designation this audit has not matched. Each one is an open item, not a pass.
